about_the_game:
"Rob your friends or die" is a game where you have to deceive your own friends in order to survive.

You and your friends decided to climb into an old and abandoned building. Unfortunately, you disturbed the peace of an ancient spirit, who locked you in a small room. Now nothing and no one can help you. You are here forever!

But...

One of you will be allowed to leave this place. Who? This is what you will find out in the course of the game, in which your life is at stake!

The rules are very simple

  • Get a role that gives you a special active or passive ability, or an extra way to win the game

  • Once at the table, blindly select one of the scrolls and do whatever it takes to keep the "blank" scroll, or whatever it takes to get rid of the "cursed" scroll.

  • The round ends if the player steals the "cursed" scroll. For this, the player is sent to a room with 6 mirrors.

  • The player must choose one of the mirrors. If the "regular" mirror was chosen, the player returns to his place and continues the game. If, after looking in the mirror, the player encounters a spirit, the game ends for him.

  • After selecting a mirror, the round starts over again.

  • If you are the only survivor, you win and can leave this room.

Recommended:

short_description: Rob your friends or die is a 4-player co-op game. Force your friends to take the "cursed" scroll, avoid the evil spirit and be the last one standing to win.

English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Japanese
